title: NuclearScience Iodine131DecayAnalysis

stats.done_summary: Completed the analysis of flame speed vs chamber pressure. The data was split into two regimes at 82 kPa. A quadratic model was fit to the first regime (R2=0.9978) and a linear model to the second (R2=0.9452). The report and figures have been generated and saved.
